content.text:
I found an existing Ubuntu host module at `modules/home-manager/hosts/wanda/containers.nix`, explicitly marked for a future Podman/Quadlet setup; it currently installs Docker Compose tooling only. Podman itself is already installed at the NixOS system layer for NixOS hosts, but a Home Manager-only setup would be host-specific and is best suited to Wanda.

Rootless Podman also has system prerequisites outside Home Manager (notably subordinate UID/GID mappings), so I need to confirm scope before changing configuration.

```text
/usr/local/bin/docker
→ /Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin/docker
```

Version: Docker 28.1.1.

Homebrew also reports `docker-desktop` installed. Your Nix config has Docker Desktop commented out, so it was installed previously or outside the current declarative config.
